test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a code language, BRAIN is coded as YIZRM and COACH is coded as XLZXS. What is the code for ENTRY in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f1010bb97fa3c69ed24a3e1b80794aa5de1719501dd087f0a78a645a2eaa06f.png] 

For 'BRAIN' is coded as 'YIZRM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e312b8d4210e02fc1084eb0cf6d836dff48b1184af837256da92141370a69cc7.png] 

For 'COACH' is coded as 'XLZXS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a09cd36145bf4a0d00f6b4e2d6b7f631188b855ba0c354674b64f9b3765725be.png] 

Similarly, for '**ENTRY'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db006c62ac1cc50f6e35628282ba31a56452c8c1d568a5e04ea150532cb25d92.png] 

So, 'ENTRY' will be coded as 'VMGIB'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
